gen-megrim-gf-miriam-libre: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with every stroke ending at one measured thickness. Miriam Libre, a sans-serif with generous bends in its s and sturdy tall lowercase, gives that spare sci-fi line something solid to stand on.
gen-megrim-gf-montserrat-underline: Megrim keeps its angular, futuristic strokes at a single measured thickness. Megrim does the drama, with a skyward x-height line, while Montserrat Underline, a sans-serif, does the steady work with breathing counters and round bowls.
gen-megrim-gf-mozilla-headline: Futuristic and angular, Megrim keeps every stroke at a drawn-wire thickness. Mozilla Headline, a friendly contemporary sans with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, feels like a warm room beside that blueprint.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with flat, unmodulated line weight, ending every stroke at one measured thickness. Noto Sans Brahmi adds a high mean line and open-ended curves.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-cham: Angular and futuristic, Megrim has a marker-drawn plainness in every character. Noto Sans Cham, a modern sans-serif with tall rounded lowercase and plenty of entry space, supplies the strength: plain lettering up top, generous shapes below.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari is a modern sans with an open lower curve on its g and a compact skyline. But Megrim's neon-tube strokes belong up top, leaving this body to read smoothly down a full page.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Sharp, wiry, a little sci-fi: that's Megrim. It handles the showy angles, while Noto Sans Elbasan, with large lowercase and terminals that never pinch shut, does the everyday reading.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and modern, with apertures open throughout. Megrim's marker-nib line, angular and futuristic, ignores direction entirely, which gives the heading its bite against ascenders that barely clear the x-height.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Megrim is angular and futuristic, drawn at a single weight throughout. Where it brings sharp, skyward drama, Noto Sans Glagolitic, a sans-serif, brings a sturdy, tall-bodied lowercase and round shapes that read clearly small.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Professional in manner, Noto Sans Grantha is a sans-serif with tall little letters that never snag on a closed-up bowl. But Megrim's crossbars match its stems in thickness, and that sharp consistency is what the heading does best.
